entities.name: Sokenzan
entities.description: Kamigawa's largest mountain range, home to Akki, bandits, yamabushi shamans and ronin.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: A place lying north of Sokenzan.

entities.name: Godo
entities.description: A bandit king who ruled the mountain ronin during the Kami War.

entities.name: Tendo Peaks
entities.description: The steepest mountains in Kamigawa, deep within Sokenzan.

entities.name: Untaidake
entities.description: The tallest mountain in Kamigawa, guarded by Ryusaki Kumano.

entities.name: Ryusei, the Falling Star
entities.description: The dragon kami who guards Sokenzan.

entities.name: Shinka
entities.description: A keep in Sokenzan where Hidetsugu and his o-bakemono practised oni summoning.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: An ogre-mage who practised summoning oni at Shinka.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: A rebel organization desiring freedom from Imperial tyranny, centered in Sokenzan.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: A war during which Godo ruled bandits and ronin.

events.summary: Sokenzan became the center of the Asari Uprisers, rebels seeking freedom from Imperial tyranny.
events.quote: The Sokenzan became the center for the Asari Uprisers

relations.quote: The Sokenzan is guarded by the dragon kami Ryusei , the Falling Star.

relations.note: Ruled bandits and ronin there during the Kami War.
